contexts.text: The coins of gold and silver (there, are correspondences).
They may be compared to impostors who coin false monies, and gild them...
They are like coins made of the lees of oil, or dried dung, and overlaid with gold.
There appeared... great silver coins, which were turned into a thicker plate of silver, which filled the pocket of my garment. It perhaps signified those things which have now been given me.
In a dream I had gold given in coins... Nordberg changed them into other gold, not monetized.
